# May I

> Premium, custom-coded websites and landing pages for businesses, plus GoHighLevel (GHL) business automation and CRM systems - based in Holon (חולון), Israel, serving clients nationwide. No templates, no Wix, no WordPress site-builders. Clean code, fast performance, built ready for both classic SEO and GEO/AEO (AI answer engines).

May I is a boutique studio led by Rotem, based in Holon (חולון), Israel - building premium landing pages and business/brand websites, and setting up GoHighLevel (GHL) automation and CRM systems, for companies who want their digital presence and operations to match how exceptional they actually are.

## What we do
- Premium landing page builds: custom-coded, high-converting, built for lead generation and sales - not template-based.
- Premium business/brand website builds: multi-page, custom-coded, fast, matched to brand identity, full technical SEO baked in from the start.
- GoHighLevel (GHL) automation and CRM setup: lead management, automated follow-ups, client tracking, full business systemization - not just web design.
- No pricing published publicly; engagement starts with a scoping call.

## Location
Based in Holon (חולון), Israel. Serves clients across Israel nationwide - remote-friendly, not limited to the local area.

## Who it's for
Israeli businesses and brands - particularly larger companies and premium/prestige brands - who have outgrown or never wanted a generic Wix/WordPress-template site, want a site that is fast, custom, and credible, and/or need their lead-gen and CRM systemized with GoHighLevel.

## Differentiators
- Fully custom code, not a page-builder or template - every site is unique to the client.
- Deep collaborative scoping process (joint brainstorming, shared deadlines) rather than a fixed package.
- Long-term partnership after launch, not a one-off delivery.
- Full transparency throughout design and build.
- Real, verified 5-star client reviews (Google-verified) - see aggregateRating on both pages.
